Class SeasonalController

java.lang.Object
SeasonalController
public class SeasonalController extends Object
Manager feature: add a new seasonal menu item to the POS, along with its recipe. The recipe can use existing inventory items and brand-new ones, which are created in inventory when the item is saved. Everything is saved in one transaction.
